title: Android XML RadioButton: button tint states
purpose: Check inherited Android XML buttonTint selector colors on RadioButton and verify group selection and right-to-left placement.
changes: Added literal and supported color-state-selector buttonTint to XML RadioButton. The focused example has an independent tinted radio group with selected, unselected and disabled options.
steps: Scroll to Android XML buttonTint. Standard is selected with a blue ring and dot; Express has an amber ring; Unavailable has a gray ring.
Touch and hold Express. Its ring should turn red while pressed. Release: Express becomes blue and selected, while Standard becomes amber and unselected.
Try selecting Unavailable. It must stay gray and must not change the selected option.

Turn on Right-to-left layout near the top. The rings should move to the right; select Standard and confirm the group still has one selection. Choose OK if the steps work, or Reject and describe the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: Each radio indicator follows its checked, unchecked, pressed or disabled color; selecting an enabled option clears the previous selection and disabled options do not select.
limits: Tint colors Bhoo's existing radio ring and dot. Custom Android button drawables, tint blend modes and exact Android pixel or motion parity remain open.

references.scope: Inherited button tint and drawable state.

validation: 140 Android XML importer tests passed, including RadioButton tint selectors.
Rust RadioButton tint test passed for checked, unchecked, pressed and disabled colors; two radio-group selection tests passed.
